//: PR CheckMate configuration template. Place this file at your repository root as 'pr-checkmate.json'. Every value below is the built-in DEFAULT — delete any block you do not want to change, because the file is deep-merged with the defaults. Keys starting with '//' are comments and are ignored. Full per-check reference: https://github.com/Mybono/pr_checkmate_public
//1-scope: WHERE CHECKS LOOK. 'sourcePath' may be a string or an array. 'ignoreDirs' REPLACES the default ignore list rather than extending it, so copy the defaults you still want.
//2-severity: UNIVERSAL ON/OFF SWITCH, keyed by a check's DISPLAY NAME (see //check-names below). 'off' removes the check before it runs; 'error' promotes a warning to a failure; 'warn' demotes a failure to a warning. This works for every check, including those with no 'enabled' flag of their own.

npm-audit.//auditLevel: info | low | moderate | high | critical. Only DIRECT dependencies at or above this level block.
npm-audit.//ignore: Package names that never block, but are still reported as warnings.

migrationSafety.//paths: Globs treated as migrations. Setting this REPLACES the defaults listed here.

dependency.//ignore: Dependency names or globs depcheck should ignore. Only sent to depcheck when non-empty, so an empty list leaves your own .depcheckrc in force.

outdatedDeps.//timeoutMs: Cap on 'npm outdated'. On timeout the check skips rather than fails.

licenseCheck.//: GPL/LGPL/AGPL in PRODUCTION dependencies fail the run. Both lists below are APPENDED to the defaults.

vulnScan.//: osv-scanner, cross-ecosystem. OPT-IN: must be exactly true. Requires osv-scanner on the runner.

grypeScan.//: Anchore grype, cross-ecosystem. ON by default but skips when grype is absent from the runner.
grypeScan.//ignore: Suppress by CVE/GHSA id or by package name.

//bannedImports: Packages that must not be ADDED. Empty means the check is inert. severity defaults to 'warn'; use 'error' to fail the run.
//5-git-and-pr: Checks on the diff and on pull-request metadata.

todoFixme.//requireTicket: When true, a TODO must reference a ticket id — '#123' or 'PROJ-456'.

largeFiles.//allow: Globs exempted from the size limit. APPENDED to a built-in lockfile allow-list.

missingTests.//ignore: Globs that never require an accompanying test. Setting this REPLACES the defaults, which cover *.d.ts, index files and *.config.*.

//customRules: Your own regex rules run against added diff lines. Each needs 'name' and 'pattern'; optional 'message', 'severity' (error|warn), 'include', 'exclude', 'flags'.

commitlint.//ignores: Regex sources for titles to skip, e.g. release PRs.

duplicate.//ignore: Test and mock paths are excluded by default because test setup legitimately repeats.

deadCode.//ignoreFiles: REGEX sources (not globs), matched against reported file paths. Setting this REPLACES the defaults.

coverage.//: OPT-IN: must be exactly true. Reads an existing coverage summary; it does not run your tests.
coverage.//reportPath: Path or array of paths to a coverage summary.

licenseHeader.//: OPT-IN: must be exactly true. Requires a header matching 'pattern' within the first 'lines' lines of each changed source file.

//7-linters: ESLint, Prettier, cspell and markdownlint. 'rules' blocks are MERGED with the defaults; 'ignorePatterns' and 'ignorePaths' are APPENDED.

cspell.//words: Project vocabulary that should not be reported as misspelled.
cspell.//dictionaries: Bundled non-English dictionaries: fr, ru, uk, he, es.

//8-languages: Language is auto-detected. A check skips when its language is absent, and runner-dependency tools skip when the binary is missing — so leaving everything enabled is safe. TypeScript and JavaScript have no block of their own: configure them through 'eslint', 'prettier' and 'typecheck' above.

python.//typeChecker: mypy | pyright — needs the tool on the runner.
